verdict.rationale: Modal's own marketing and pricing pages say GPUs attached to a sandbox are billed 'by the second with no reserved capacity' and that you 'only pay for what you use' without pre-allocating CPU or memory. That covers the core of usage-based, per-second sandbox billing. However, per-second granularity is stated explicitly only for GPUs, and there is no detailed rate documentation for sandbox CPU and memory, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: explicit per-second billing statement for sandbox CPU/memory, documented rate table or billing-granularity docs specific to Sandboxes, clarity on whether idle sandbox time is billed, independent hands-on corroboration of actual billing behavior.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can pay per second only for the compute a sandbox actually uses

citations.quote: Attach to any sandbox, scale to thousands of concurrent runs, pay by the second with no reserved capacity.
Only pay for what you use. Burst up to what you need without over-allocating CPU or memory in advance.
say what resources you need explicitly and pay for what you need only
